The ideal $\mathfrak n=\mathfrak mC$ is prime, and $B=C_{\mathfrak n}=A_{\mathfrak m}$ is the local ring at $s$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak nB$ and residue field $\kappa(s)$. 1.2 Put $L^\bullet=K^\bullet\otimes_A C$, a bounded finite-free complex by 1.1, and $M^\bullet=L^\bullet\otimes_C B$. For every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $Y$, there is a unique ideal $I\subseteq A$ such that, over $U$, $$i^{-1}(U)\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A/I).$$ Conversely, every quotient map $A\to A/I$ induces a closed immersion $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. supplier_support.claim: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes. Then $f$ is a closed map of topological spaces: for every closed subset $Z\subseteq|X|$ its image $f(Z)$ is closed in $|S|$. In particular $f(X)$ is closed. Moreover, for every $S$-scheme $T$ the base-changed projection $$f_T:X\times_S T\longrightarrow T$$ is closed, so the image of $X\times_S T$, and of any closed subset of it, is closed in $|T|$.
